prompt: A watercolor illustration depicts a bustling construction site where soft pigments bleed into one another to define forms. On the far left, a woman in a yellow hard hat stands firmly with her hands on her hips, observing the scene. Next to her, a small brown dog sits patiently on a pile of gravel, its tail curled neatly around its paws. A man in a blue vest points toward the center of the frame, directing attention to a large steel beam that rests horizontally on two sawhorses. The beam shows signs of rust along its edges. Beside the beam, a child in a striped shirt looks up with wide eyes, holding a toy truck tightly in both hands. A woman in a green scarf leans against a concrete pillar nearby, sipping from a silver thermos. In the center, a crane operator in an orange jacket peers out from the glass cab of a towering yellow crane, which dominates the background skyline. Below the crane, a foreman in a white helmet gestures emphatically toward a stack of wooden planks. A worker in gray overalls lifts one of these planks, straining slightly under the weight. To the right, a black cat perches atop a red toolbox, watching the activity with detached interest. A delivery driver in a purple uniform hands a clipboard to the foreman, who accepts it with a nod. Near them, a stack of blue barrels sits untouched by the chaos. A pigeon flies low over the barrels, wings spread wide. An engineer in a suit stands next to the engineer's table, reviewing rolled-up blueprints. A stray soccer ball lies deflated near the edge of the site. There is no heavy machinery noise implied by the stillness. There is no rain falling from the sky.
